providerOrder.title: Provider order
providerOrder.description: Integration ids of the geocoders to ask, in order (fallback chain). Only listed geocoders are asked; an id that names no loaded geocoder is skipped. Also settable via INTEGRATION_GEOCODING_PROVIDER_ORDER.

nominatimUrl.title: Nominatim lookup URL
nominatimUrl.description: Base URL used by the orchestrator's OSM-ref place resolver (independent of the provider chain). Defaults to the public OSM instance.
